stem: Why did gasoline prices spike during the 1970s and early 1980s?

options.label: A
options.text: A natural disaster impeded offshore drilling for oil.

options.label: B
options.text: Congress imposed new regulations on foreign energy companies.

options.label: C
options.text: Conflicts in the Middle East disrupted the distribution of oil.

options.label: D
options.text: Congress introduced new legislation to increase the fuel efficiency of vehicles.
